text: Up at six to do chem before school. Stuck on the same stoichiometry question for twenty minutes. 182 days until the DSE and I still can't do moles.
Mock results came back. Chem 38/80. Everyone compared scores in the corridor. I said I did okay and walked away fast.
Tutor said anyone below 50 should think about dropping the elective. Pretty sure he looked at me. Dad texted asking how the mock went. Left it on read.
Told them at dinner. Dad went quiet, Mum said maybe not medicine, then they argued like I wasn't there. 我知佢哋擔心我。 Explained moles to Jason's sister later and it finally clicked for me too.
